source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Low hemoglobin with macrocytosis and a low vitamin B12 level.","B":"Low hemoglobin with normocytosis and an elevated ferritin level in an inflammatory state.","C":"Normal hemoglobin with macrocytosis and increased body iron stores.","D":"Low hemoglobin with microcytosis and a low ferritin level."}}
source_row.rationale: Iron deficiency anemia commonly produces low hemoglobin and microcytosis, and a low ferritin level supports depleted iron stores. Ferritin must still be interpreted in clinical context because inflammation and other conditions can raise it.
source_row.source_detail: Laboratory evaluation: low hemoglobin, microcytosis as deficiency progresses, and low ferritin supporting depleted iron stores.
